scripts.build: bun ../../src/index.ts resources run --priority ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY:-coding} --cpus ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS:-1} --memory-mib ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB:-2048} -- sh -c 'bun run sync:shared && vite build "$@"' --
scripts.sync:shared: bun run --cwd ../desktop svelte-kit sync && bun run --cwd ../reports svelte-kit sync
scripts.check: bun ../../src/index.ts resources run --priority ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY:-agent-test} --cpus ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS:-1} --memory-mib ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB:-2048} -- sh -c 'bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run audit "$@"' --
scripts.typecheck: bun ../../src/index.ts resources run --priority ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY:-agent-test} --cpus ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS:-1} --memory-mib ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB:-2048} -- sh -c 'svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json "$@"' --
scripts.lint: bun ../../src/index.ts resources run --priority ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY:-coding} --cpus ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS:-1} --memory-mib ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB:-2048} -- sh -c 'svelte-kit sync && eslint . "$@"' --
scripts.test:unit: bun ../../src/index.ts resources run --priority ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY:-agent-test} --cpus ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS:-1} --memory-mib ${HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB:-2048} -- sh -c 'bun run sync:shared && vitest run "$@"' --
